name: Sand Street Angels
description: Sand Street Angels was a youth street gang based in the Sands Street neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York, active during the 1950s. The gang is documented alongside the Mau Maus in the book Brooklyn Rumble: Mau Maus, Sand Street Angels, and the End of an Era, which details a gang killing in February 1959 near the Brooklyn Paramount Theater.
